reviews.text: As an emergency room, they only have one doctor and you often have to wait, but it is always open.
Excellent performance. I've seen that they take great care in handling our little furry friends.
Good evening Emanuela, thank you for your very positive feedback.

Excellent experience with Dr. Gracis. My Labrador, Cocoa, underwent a gingivectomy, epulis removal, and extraction. I was very anxious, but the doctor was excellent with both her and us. What I really appreciated was the post-procedure explanation: she took the time to explain step by step what she had found, what she had removed, and how to manage the following days at home. Professional, clear, empathetic, #1! Thank you, doctor!
Thank you Michela for your positive review!

Hi Piero,
Thank you for taking the time to share your opinion.
We wish you a good day,
AniCura Veterinary Clinic San Siro

Emergency visit for my 8-year-old French bulldog. I can only give this veterinary clinic a well-deserved 5 stars.
A special thanks goes to Dr. Bossetti, whose calm and professional manner immediately put both me and my pet at ease. He was very clear in his explanations, answering all my questions with patience and great kindness. It's clear he truly loves his job.
Dr. Bizzocchi was equally exceptional. Her kindness and attention to my little one were touching. She handled the situation with incredible sensitivity, instilling a sense of security that immediately put me at ease. It's rare to find such a combination of medical expertise and compassion.
I recommend this clinic to anyone looking not only for high-quality medical care, but also for an environment where their pet is treated like a member of the family. A heartfelt thank you to the entire team, and especially to Dr. Bossetti and Dr. Bizzocchi!

Hi Giuliana,
We're glad you're satisfied too.
Thank you so much for this review!

I'd like to sincerely thank Dr. Asperio and his wonderful assistant Marta for taking care of my Mochi. ❤️

Mochi had fractured his femur and suffered several broken legs following a nasty fall from a balcony. He underwent surgery, and thanks to their care and professionalism, he is now doing very well and is recovering well.

The price is certainly high, but considering the severity of the situation, the quality of the work, and the attention they gave to Mochi, I can say it was worth it.

Thank you so much for caring for my little one and for being with us during such a difficult time. ❤️
